repository-github.title: Choose a GitHub repository
repository-github.updateServer: Update the selected server to choose repositories from GitHub. Existing folder registration remains available.
repository-github.noProfiles: No connected GitHub profiles on this page. Connect a PAT in Integrations or read another profile page.
repository-github.staleProfile: The selected profile changed. Refresh profiles and select its current version.
repository-github.cached: Cached page; refresh before selecting a repository.
repository-github.empty: No repositories are accessible on this page.
repository-github.credentials: The PAT reads repository metadata. Clone uses this computer's Git or SSH credentials.
